component.name: paint.c
component.summary: Edit images with layers and effects

description.p: paint.c is a fast, native image and photo editor written in C. It follows the workflow of a well known Windows image editor, so its tools, menus, shortcuts and dialogs feel familiar from the first click, and it opens and saves that editor's .pdn files with their layers intact.

ul.li: Layers with opacity, 14 blend modes and visibility
Unlimited history with a clickable history panel
Selections, magic wand, brushes, clone stamp, recolor, gradients and fills
Shapes, lines and curves, and text that stay editable until finished
Adjustments and effects with live previews, including curves and levels
Opens and saves PDN, PNG, JPEG, JPEG XL, AVIF, WebP, TIFF, BMP, GIF, TGA, DDS and OpenRaster
Optional plugins for even more effects

screenshot.caption: Curves with a live preview in the dark theme

description.p: Packaging fixes: the desktop entry passes older desktop file validators and the AppImage carries a PNG icon for thumbnails.
Flatpak support: the app id is now io.github.vancevoj.paintc, opening a file while paint.c runs in the Flatpak reaches the open window, and the Text tool lists the fonts installed on the system.

Fixes a canvas that kept part of a closed image after opening another, prefers native Wayland on compositors without wp_fifo_v1 (KWin before 6.4) with a Display server setting, and adds the plugin host features the optional plugins use.
